Theme

switch off verb

also turn off, turn the light off, turn off the phone, turn off the computer, shut down

modern

Traupman 262, s.v. turn off
Andresian pp. 14–15
Traupman 262, 399

exstinguō, exstinguere

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

extinguish

Using it for electrical lights is a modern application. Traupman and Andresian use it for switching off a computer or a phone too.

Other words

  • claudō, claudere, clausī, clausum — shut down (a computer)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · modern · Traupman 262 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

  • expediō, expedīre, expedīvī, expedītum — Traupman’s “turn off”

    verb, fourth conjugation · avoid · modern · Traupman 124: to turn off the light, lūmen expedīre; the radio, radiophōnum expedīre · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Classically “free, disentangle, get ready” (Lewis & Short); nothing in it suggests switching off. Use exstinguere.

Examples

  • Exstingue lūmen.

    Turn the light off.composed

See also switch on, light, restart.

SourcesLewis & Short: exstinguo
